name: Nu/Steer/Zweck Framework
deliverable: Strategic validation against organizational mandate and execution utility

steps.text: Write three questions: now, steering, and purpose.
Record facts under Nu, then the lever and metric under Steer.
State the purpose under Zweck and park candidates that do not line up.

failure: Purpose is recited as a slogan while now-facts and levers stay vague, so every candidate passes.
intervention: Ask what would change if the purpose were different; if nothing would, the purpose is decoration.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: Used in Dutch design-led strategy practice; no single documented originator.
